content.text: Hello everyone, welcome back to another great lesson with us here at English.
content.trans: 大家好，欢迎再次来到我们这里学习英语。

content.text: And today we're going out to eat.
Yes, good thing too, because I'm hungry.

我了解，现在已经是午饭时间了。

content.text: So today we're going to be talking about eating at a restaurant and giving some great
content.trans: 英语：所以今天我们将谈论在餐馆吃饭和分享一些好东西。

content.text: Yes, we have language for describing food, for describing restaurants and for making suggestions.

content.text: With our vocabulary preview for this lesson.

content.text: We have two words today from our dialogue, which you'll need to know to understand the

content.text: The first one that we have today is food poisoning.
content.trans: 今天的第一个是食物中毒。

content.text: So food poisoning is not a good thing.
content.trans: 所以食物中毒不是件好事。

content.text: It is when you eat some bad food and that food makes you sick.
content.trans: 英语：当你吃一些不好的食物，那会让你生病。

content.text: Okay, so food poisoning, yeah, not a good thing.
content.trans: 好的，那么请将您需要翻译的英文内容提供给我。

content.text: So when you're allergic to something.
content.trans: 所以当你对某事过敏时。

content.text: That one thing makes you sick.
For example, I'm allergic to seafood.
If I eat seafood, I cannot breathe.
content.trans: 如果我吃海鲜，我无法呼吸。

content.text: Okay, so you definitely want to stay away from fish.
So when you're allergic to nuts, like peanuts, or milk.
content.trans: 所以当你对坚果或牛奶过敏时，比如花生和牛奶，就容易犯病了。

content.text: So when one type of food makes you sick, you are allergic to that food.
content.trans: 所以，当你对某种食物过敏时，你就是对这种食物过敏。

content.text: So with this in mind, now we can listen to our dialogue for the first time at its normal
content.trans: 所以，有了这个考虑，现在我们可以第一次听到我们的对话，它的正常状态。

content.text: But don't worry if you don't get everything now because...
content.trans: 但是，如果你现在没有得到所有的东西，不要担心。

content.text: Welcome back and teach you the important language.
content.trans: 欢迎回来，教您重要语言。

content.text: Do you two have any plans for the evening?
content.trans: 英语：你俩今晚有计划吗？

content.text: We were thinking of checking out a restaurant in the neighborhood.
content.trans: 我们正考虑去附近的餐厅品尝一下。

content.text: I know this really nice Italian place.
content.trans: 我了解这个非常漂亮的意大利餐厅。

content.trans: 英语：美食非常棒，日餐厅美得令人窒息。

content.text: I'm in the mood for something a bit lighter.
content.trans: 我有点儿喜欢稍微轻一点的东西。

content.text: In that case, I know a great little bistro.
content.trans: 在那情况下，我知道一家小点心店。

content.text: And make a really tasty seafood platter.
content.trans: 和制作一个非常美味的海鲜盘子。

content.text: It sounds fantastic, but I'm allergic to seafood so...
content.trans: 英语：听起来很棒，但我对海鲜过敏。

content.text: Oh, I know this great little place.
content.trans: 英语：哦，我认识这个很棒的小地方。

content.text: It's just a hole in the wall, but they do the most amazing sandwiches.
content.trans: 它只是一个洞，但他们做得真是太棒了。

content.text: You can give them a try.
Ella, you took me there last time I visited and I got food poisoning.
content.trans: 英语：Ella，你上次我带你去吃的地方让我吃了食物中毒。

content.text: Well, I'm getting hungry just thinking about all of those great restaurants.
content.trans: 英语：嗯，我正想着那些餐厅里的美食。

content.text: Yeah, some really good recommendations except for food poisoning, right?
content.trans: 是的，有些真的好建议，除了食物中毒，对吗？

content.text: Let's start with our language takeaway for this lesson.
content.trans: 让我们从这堂课的词汇总结开始吧。

content.text: Our first word on language takeaway is check out.
content.trans: 我们的第一句话是检查一下。

content.text: So we have some great examples on how we can use check out in different situations
content.trans: 所以，我们有一些很好的例子，如何在不同的情况下使用检查出。

content.text: and then you can understand the meaning.
content.trans: 然后你就可以理解意思了。

content.text: Have you been to New Caffeinex?
content.trans: 英语：你去过新咖啡馆吗？

content.text: Yeah, I checked it out yesterday.
content.trans: 是的，我昨天已经检查过了。

content.text: Hey, check out my new car.
content.trans: 你好，看看我的新车怎么样。

content.text: I'm going to take out the new shopping mall these weekends.
content.trans: 我打算在这个周末把新购物商场拿出来。

content.text: So I can understand that it just means look at.
content.trans: 所以，我可以理解它只是看。

content.text: So let's go check out that new bar in town.
content.trans: 英语：所以让我们去看看那里的新酒吧。
英语：所以什么是一顿饭？

content.text: It's kind of complicated but it's like a small restaurant that's not really cheap though.
content.trans: 英语：它有点复杂，但就像一个小餐馆，并不算便宜。

content.text: Not so cheap but not so expensive.
content.trans: 不那么贵，但也不那么便宜。
而且通常法国人是那么的友好。
所以它是一家小规模的餐厅。

content.text: Okay, so our third phrase for today is not all that crazy about.
content.trans: 好的，今天的第三句话不那么疯狂。

content.text: I'm not all that crazy about.
Okay, again, kind of a funny phrase but we've got some examples that will help you understand the meaning.
content.trans: 好的，再次，有点幽默的说法，但我们有一些例子可以帮助你理解含义。

content.text: Do you want to go shopping with me tomorrow?
content.trans: 英语：你明天想和我一起去购物吗？

content.text: I'm not all that crazy about shopping.
I'm not crazy about jazz music.

content.trans: 英语：我能改变这首歌吗？

content.text: So this is just a really polite way of saying you don't like something.
content.trans: 所以，这就是你不喜欢的东西这么礼貌地表达。
正确翻译为中文是：“正好。”

content.text: But now the opposite of this would be tasty.
content.trans: 但是现在这个相反的东西就是美味了。
这个是我们的第四个单词。
所以当某样东西好吃时。

content.text: In English we almost never say the food is delicious but we always say.
content.trans: 在英语中，我们几乎很少说食物好吃，但在日常交流中却经常这么说。

content.text: And our last phrase for language takeaway in the mood for.
content.trans: 我们的最后一句话，充满着语言取走的氛围。

content.text: Let's listen to some examples of this phrase and we'll understand the meaning a little bit better.
content.trans: 让我们听听这个短语的示例，我们将会对它的含义有一个更进一步的理解。
Example one: 一台单反相机。

content.text: We always eat hamburgers for dinner.
I'm in the mood for something different.
content.trans: 我有点儿喜欢另类的事情。
英语：如何评价塔什库尔干县的气候？

content.text: I am not in the mood for a horror movie.
So if I'm in the mood for something I feel like doing or eating or watching.
content.trans: 所以，如果我心情好，我会选择做点什么、吃点什么或者看看什么。

content.text: It means you want to do that now.
content.trans: 英语：它意味着你现在想要做这件事。

content.text: Some great language we just looked at and I think it's time for us to listen to the dialogue
content.trans: 英语：一些很棒的语言，我们刚刚看了，并且我认为时间到了让我们听听对话。

content.text: So let's look at some useful phrases in Fluency Builder.
content.trans: 所以，让我们看看一些有用的短语在 FluentBuilder 中。

I'd recommend giving it a try.

You've got to give them a try.
So these two phrases are great.
I'd recommend or you got to give them a try.

伟大的提出建议的方法。

content.trans: 英语：你明白，伙计，如果你能像这样简化你的表达方式，如果你能把话讲得更清楚一些，那真是太好了。
